svg.title: The oldest waiting ticket gets served first
svg.desc: A waiting list starts empty. Each visitor gets a lettered ticket. A new ticket goes at the end of the line. Add three. Visitors arrive with A, then B, then C. The line reads A, B, C. Serve twice. A leaves first, then B. C is next. Add D and the waiting line now reads C, D. Clear. The waiting list is empty. The Serve button should stop working until a new visitor joins.
svg.text: The oldest waiting ticket gets served first

ticket goes at the end of the line.
Visitors arrive with A, then B, then C. The line reads A, B, C.
A leaves first, then B. C is next. Add D and the waiting line now reads C, D.
